channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: 🏸 Déjà Vu on the Court: Navan vs. Julianstown - Round 2
item.description: Navan and Julianstown face off again in a thrilling badminton rematch. Join us to see if history repeats or changes on the court.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 10 Results: End of year 2024
item.description: Wrapping up 2024 with a week of intense badminton matches, featuring highs, lows, and unforgettable moments on the court.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Nights at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for Wednesday Club Nights at Claremont Stadium for exciting badminton matches and fun activities.

item.title: Thursday Club Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for Thursday Club Night at Claremont Stadium for an evening of badminton and camaraderie. Watch Navan face Dundalk in an exciting match or enjoy playing on the available court.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Week 9 Fixtures
item.description: Check out the schedule for Week 9 with 13 exciting badminton matches lined up, both home and away.

item.description: Join us tonight at Claremont Stadium for exciting badminton action with matches featuring Navan 'C' vs Kildalkey and Navan vs Bailieboro.

item.title: Derby Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for Derby Night at Claremont Stadium! Teams that usually train together face off in exciting matches. Don't miss the fun and competition!

item.description: A week of mixed badminton results with standout performances and future potential. Get well wishes to injured players.

item.title: Exciting Club Night on Monday
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for an evening of thrilling badminton matches featuring Navan, Kildalkey, and Mullagh. Don't miss the action and test your skills on the court!

item.description: A week filled with big wins, a draw, and challenging matches as our teams demonstrated resilience and strength on the courts.
